# Repository Instructions

This file is a repo-wide Copilot bridge, not the canonical workflow specification.

- Start from [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It remains the primary workflow entrypoint.
- Default workflow entrypoints are the three scenario skills: `clarify`, `delivery-quality-first`, and `capture-memory`.
- Treat repository documents as the source of truth for shared rules and facts; use GitHub Copilot Memory for durable personal or repo-scoped experience.
- If an execution plan exists, follow the update discipline in [docs/exec-plans/index.md](../docs/exec-plans/index.md) and do not rewrite the original implementation steps.
- Keep this file minimal. Workflow details live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [docs/exec-plans/index.md](../docs/exec-plans/index.md).
